surfaces.atlas_console: MCP App entry point; public setup or authenticated connection state. Hosted Console hides unsupported local invitations and offers the Codex installer command; runtime presence remains distinct from authorisation. Clerk sign-in/sign-up, pilot-access, profile email/username and copyable existing Atlas user ID are owner-Console-only; profile edits use Clerk and confer no Atlas authority; inline App continues to hand off human authentication. Hosted named hosted/direct OAuth installation selection, resource URL and revoke are owner-Console-only; MCP App stays an agent surface. Codex CLI installer opens a focused owner approval page, hands back only the scoped public MCP URL, runs native OAuth and checks discovery; Claude Code CLI installer uses the same approval handoff with native add/login/get; identity is confirmed by reading atlas://me in a fresh host chat. Signed-in Getting started help sheet offers assistant prompts, terminal and manual guidance; Overview, Lines and Account use it as the primary connection path, with separate manual configuration. It confers no authority. Hosted Claude/ChatGPT connector setup remains separate. Existing standalone calls/controller/Pi keep installation bearers; no OAuth credentials are placed in generated plugins. Hosted public guide reports authentication mode; hosted plugin targets authenticated /mcp; owner signup and OAuth consent stay in Console. CLI exposes the same authenticated tools/resources; controller/Pi retain bearer profiles.
surfaces.atlas_registration_inspect: Skill/CLI inspection; MCP App header uses atlas_console.
surfaces.atlas_lines_register: MCP App registration; owner authorises installation in Console.
surfaces.atlas_endpoints_attach: Skill/CLI only: persistent clientKey belongs to the harness consumer, not an ephemeral panel.
surfaces.atlas_contacts_list: MCP App reachable lines grouped by subscriber; owner Console/HTTP manages invitations, acceptance, exposure and revoke. Pi selectable through explicit reviewed tool configuration.
surfaces.atlas_messages_send: MCP App whisper/subscriber memo composer; pending invitation audiences, classes, deadlines and causation through skill/CLI and explicitly configured Pi tools.
surfaces.atlas_messages_list: MCP App paged Inbox; harness manages per-consumer/filter cursors.
surfaces.atlas_messages_acknowledge: Skill/CLI only: requires an explicitly fetched event and that harness endpoint. Panel reads do not acknowledge.
surfaces.atlas_resources_read: MCP App memory URI resolver; other resource kinds through skill/CLI.
surfaces.atlas_context_publish: MCP App private expiring snapshot composer; sharing in owner Console.
surfaces.atlas_endpoints_state: Skill/CLI only: runtime reports its own state; a panel cannot infer worker activity.
surfaces.atlas_services: MCP App Services inspection and runtime proposal; connector consent/deploy/stop/delete in owner Console. Explicit reads/runs and child_prepare through skill/CLI.
surfaces.atlas_context_vaults: MCP App Memory vaults discovery and effective-access state.
surfaces.atlas_context_search: MCP App bounded search; advanced metadata filters through skill/CLI.
surfaces.atlas_context_read: MCP App selected memory inspection; pinned revision reads through resource URI or skill/CLI.
surfaces.atlas_context_write: Skill/CLI: persist full request and operation token outside transient panel state before write.
surfaces.atlas_context_import: Skill/CLI: persist full source-aware request and retry identity; no automatic ingestion.
surfaces.atlas_context_export: Skill/CLI: bounded selected-ID export, no whole-vault sync.
surfaces.atlas_context_policy_inspect: MCP App policy pages for explicitly authorised controller installations; owner Console also inspects.
surfaces.atlas_context_policy_propose: MCP App exact scoped proposal for authorised controller installations; human approval remains in Console.
surfaces.atlas_context_policy_status: MCP App proposal lookup; decisions only in owner Console.
surfaces.atlas_inbox_next: Harness/CLI and explicitly configured Pi tool only: endpoint and persistent request ID belong to the consumer; transient MCP App retains manual pagination.
surfaces.atlas_messages_status: Tool/CLI and explicitly configured Pi delivery inspection; MCP App displays send result and envelope, no automatic status polling.
